topic.title: Accelerated Alternating and Minimax Optimization
topic.overview: This topic studies algorithms for coupled optimization problems, including alternating minimization, primal–dual updates, and minimax objectives. It asks how momentum, update ordering, and local smoothness can improve convergence. A representative method combines alternating minimization with acceleration and adapts to problem properties without requiring their constants in advance.
topic.whyItMatters: Many learning procedures involve interacting variables or an inner adversarial optimization. Their practical behavior depends on how accurately and frequently each component is updated, while guarantees differ sharply between convex settings and more general nonconvex games.
topic.evolution: The representatives extend from momentum and overrelaxation to adaptive primal–dual methods and accelerated constrained minimax algorithms. Recent studies analyze the benefits of alternating updates and reinterpret sharpness-aware minimization through explicit inner–outer dynamics, examining where common approximations match the intended objective.
openQuestions: How should computation be divided between inner and outer updates?
Which acceleration mechanisms remain stable when curvature changes or gradients are estimated noisily?

papers.title: Adaptive Riemannian ADMM for Nonsmooth Optimization: Optimal Complexity without Smoothing
papers.tldr: Adaptive Riemannian ADMM handles nonsmooth manifold optimization without smoothing while matching an optimal iteration bound.

papers.title: Affine-Invariant Global Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of BFGS under Self-Concordance
papers.tldr: The paper proves affine-invariant global convergence guarantees for BFGS on strictly convex, strongly self-concordant objectives with weak-Wolfe line searches.

papers.title: Balancing Gradient and Hessian Queries in Non-Convex Optimization
papers.tldr: New nonconvex optimization methods provide provable trade-offs between gradient and Hessian queries for finding points with small gradients.

papers.title: Constrained Optimization From a Control Perspective via Feedback Linearization
papers.tldr: The paper establishes convergence theory for feedback-linearization optimization, connects it to SQP, and develops inequality-constrained and momentum-accelerated extensions.

papers.title: Efficient Quadratic Corrections for Frank-Wolfe Algorithms
papers.tldr: Efficient quadratic correction steps strengthen convergence guarantees and accelerate Frank–Wolfe methods across the studied optimization problems.

papers.title: Efficiently Escaping Saddle Points under Generalized Smoothness via Self-Bounding Regularity
papers.tldr: A unified analysis establishes convergence of first-order optimization methods to second-order stationary points under generalized smoothness conditions.

papers.title: Escaping saddle points without Lipschitz smoothness: the power of nonlinear preconditioning
papers.tldr: Under broader smoothness conditions, nonlinear gradient updates including clipping preserve saddle avoidance and admit efficient second-order stationarity guarantees.

papers.title: Extragradient Method for $(L_0, L_1)$-Lipschitz Root-finding Problems
papers.tldr: A new extragradient step-size strategy provides convergence guarantees under a relaxed, operator-dependent Lipschitz condition.

papers.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Stochastic Nonconvex Nonsmooth Optimization on the Riemannian Manifolds
papers.tldr: RO2NC provides finite-time stationarity guarantees for noisy, nonsmooth, nonconvex optimization on manifolds, including a version without gradients.

papers.title: Large Stepsizes Accelerate Gradient Descent for Regularized Logistic Regression
papers.tldr: For L2-regularized logistic regression on separable data, large constant steps accelerate gradient descent despite nonmonotonic objective values.

papers.title: On the Complexity of Finding Stationary Points in Nonconvex Simple Bilevel Optimization
papers.tldr: A dynamic barrier gradient method reaches a newly defined joint stationarity target in polynomial time for smooth nonconvex simple bilevel problems.

papers.title: Preference Optimization on Pareto Sets: On a Theory of Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper formalizes preference-based selection among Pareto-optimal solutions and gives a conditionally convergent algorithm, including a comparison-feedback extension.

papers.title: Quantum Speedups for Minimax Optimization and Beyond
papers.tldr: Quantum Hessian estimation enables improved function-query bounds for minimax optimization, with extensions to strongly convex–concave and non-convex settings.

papers.title: Quasi-Self-Concordant Optimization with $\ell_{\infty}$ Lewis Weights
papers.tldr: A Lewis-weight-based regression algorithm improves the linear-system-solve complexity of an oracle for constrained quasi-self-concordant optimization.

papers.title: Revisiting Frank-Wolfe for Structured Nonconvex Optimization
papers.tldr: A structured Frank-Wolfe method exploits convex-difference decompositions, matching standard stationarity complexity while enabling fewer gradient calls in specific cases.

papers.title: Semi-infinite Nonconvex Constrained Min-Max Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper proposes a primal-dual algorithm for nonconvex min-max problems with infinitely many constraints and proves conditional iteration bounds.

papers.title: Set Smoothness Unlocks Clarke Hyper-stationarity in Bilevel Optimization
papers.tldr: Set smoothness enables guaranteed computation of approximate Clarke hyper-stationary points for a broad class of nonsmooth bilevel problems.

papers.title: Sharper Convergence Rates for Nonconvex Optimisation via Reduction Mappings
papers.tldr: Well-designed reduction mappings exploit known solution geometry to improve conditioning and accelerate gradient-based nonconvex optimization.

papers.title: A Linearly Convergent Proximal Subgradient Algorithm for Sparse Portfolio Optimization with Transaction Cost
papers.tldr: The paper combines sparse portfolio holdings and transaction costs in an optimization method with proven linear convergence and favorable results on four market datasets.

papers.title: A Penalty Approach For Differentiation Through Black-box Quadratic Programming Solvers
papers.tldr: dXPP differentiates through black-box quadratic-programming solutions using a smooth penalty approximation and a smaller backward-pass linear system.

papers.title: A proximal ADMM for multiblock problems with block anti-upper triangular constraints
papers.tldr: A new convergence analysis extends proximal ADMM guarantees to structured multiblock problems that can fall outside standard matrix assumptions.

papers.title: A Tale of Two Problems: Multi-Task Bilevel Learning Meets Equality Constrained Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper connects multi-task bilevel learning to constrained multi-objective optimization and develops an algorithm with a proved rate toward Pareto stationarity.

papers.title: Finding Stationary Points by Comparisons
papers.tldr: Under smoothness assumptions, comparison-only algorithms find approximately stationary points with quadratic classical or linear quantum dependence on dimension.

papers.title: From Lyapunov Analysis to Algorithm Design in two-sided PL Minimax Optimization
papers.tldr: TALDA turns Lyapunov analysis into an algorithm-design principle, with linear convergence under the two-sided PL condition and sharper rates for weakly coupled problems.

papers.title: Inference of Online Newton Methods with Nesterov’s Accelerated Sketching
papers.tldr: Accelerated sketching makes online Newton inference computationally practical while quantifying uncertainty from both streaming data and randomized computation.

papers.title: Last-iterate Convergence of ADMM on Multi-affine Quadratic Equality Constrained Problem
papers.tldr: The paper proves conditional convergence guarantees for ADMM on structured non-convex equality-constrained problems, including linear rates under bounded constraint non-convexity.

papers.title: Lower Bounds for Frank-Wolfe on Strongly Convex Sets
papers.tldr: A constructive lower bound proves that Frank–Wolfe's uniform 1/√ε iteration guarantee is tight even with smooth, strongly convex objectives and constraint sets.

papers.title: Mirror Descent Under Generalized Smoothness
papers.tldr: A generalized smoothness condition extends mirror-descent convergence guarantees beyond Euclidean geometry while matching classical smoothness rates.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Convergence of Accelerated Gradient Methods under Generalized and $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness
papers.tldr: New analysis establishes near-optimal accelerated convergence under generalized smoothness in the small-error regime.

papers.title: Projection-Free Algorithms for Minimax Problems
papers.tldr: A unified smoothing framework gives projection-free minimax algorithms convergence guarantees without a predetermined iteration horizon.

papers.title: Riemannian Dueling Optimization
papers.tldr: Two Riemannian algorithms extend comparison-only optimization to curved solution spaces, including settings where projection is prohibited.

papers.title: Romberg-Extrapolated Zeroth-Order Gradient Estimator: Higher-Order Bias Reduction with Preserved Leading Directional Variance
papers.tldr: Romberg-ZOGE combines same-direction estimates at multiple radii to reduce gradient-estimation bias while preserving leading directional variance under stated smoothness conditions.

papers.title: Second-Order Bilevel Optimization with Accelerated Convergence Rates
papers.tldr: Second-order bilevel methods obtain accelerated stationarity guarantees, while reusing curvature information reduces their theoretical computational cost.

papers.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization Can Hallucinate Minimizers
papers.tldr: SAM can converge to nonstationary points of the original loss, and a short SGD warm-start mitigates this failure mode.

papers.title: Solving the Offline and Online Min-Max Problem of Non-smooth Submodular-Concave Functions: A Zeroth-Order Approach
papers.tldr: A zeroth-order method obtains expected offline convergence and an online duality-gap bound for nonsmooth submodular–concave optimization.

papers.title: Understanding SAM through Minimax Perspective
papers.tldr: A minimax gradient-flow analysis yields Multi-step SAM and explains benefits of multiple inner updates, including at large perturbation radii.
